description: This file contains functions and constants related to handling image attachments in a chat application, including image resizing, decoding, encoding to Base64, caching, and normalization of filenames.

methods.name: loadSizedImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads an image from the provided URI, resizes it to fit within maximum dimensions, and encodes it as a Base64 string, returning a PendingImageAttachment object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Bitmap
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string into a Bitmap object, utilizing caching and sampling strategies to optimize performance.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates an appropriate inSampleSize value for BitmapFactory decoding to scale images efficiently.

methods.name: normalizeAttachmentFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes a filename string, ensuring it ends with a '.jpg' extension.
